entities.title: Library tests
entities.summary: JUnit tests of the library itself: the shared fixture runners, the typed layer, structural and Gregorian validation, and java.time interop.
entities.purpose: Checks the library against the shared conformance material, read in place from ../../conformance, and against the obligations of library-api §8. The example suites live in examples/.
boundaries: Most tests here predate AGENTS.md section 1 and are brought in line when next changed (UtvTest and TemporalContextTest already follow it).
Tests mirror production (AGENTS.md 1.9): each test class is named after the class it exercises, and verification.json names it.
